wp_prediction_metadata.note: Run WP frozen predictions (15 Oct 2026, before any WP data): fold edges alpha_N of the stripe windows of period P = 2 (N + 3) along log10 T = -0.115 at the fold of the 2-cycle 'is it' (alpha_c = 0.06279827, a = -4.834227, b = -25.428512 from the paper). Law L: the paper's fit to the fold edges of periods 16-20, alpha_N - alpha_c = 0.0266 / (N + 0.15)^2. Model R: passage from the measured natural reinjection point v_r (oriented coordinate; median -4.9e-4, measured -3.0e-4 to -7.4e-4) through the normal-form channel, n(eps) = (pi/2 - arctan(v_r / sqrt(|a| eps / |b|))) / sqrt(ab eps), windows where n(eps_N) = N + c, with the one offset c fitted to the fold edges of periods 16-20. Test: the measured fold edges of periods 22-30 against L and R; R predicts eps_N 3-9 % below L for these periods, L none.
